name: r9-vectors-resigned-copy
note: A current native manager's re-signed copy of a stop that a removed or demoted manager signed (host-work-v1 §11.1 "A current manager's copy of a former manager's stop", condition (c); agreed with Astation, Astation #114 comments 7208700195 and 7209301522): check_resigned_copy(list, original_json, copy_json, candidate_feed_id) (bindings check_resigned_copy, JS checkResignedCopy), one shared judgement so the Mac and the Station judge a copy alike. Pure: no clock, no storage. Records are control records (r9-vectors-host-work-control's form, wire {"body":{…},"sig"}, signing input enc(["atem-host-work-control-v1", jcs(body)])), each with `signed_with` (r9-vectors-keys' test key) and `checks`, verify_control's verdict on each of the file's chains (valid with the verified signer, member:<id> for a current manager or the principal for its own key; pending or refused with its reason). Device lists: log L of r9-vectors-membership-log followed by `chain` (labels of `entries`, signed by dev-mac on L but RC7_hs7_revoke, r9-vectors-membership-log's HS7_revoke byte for byte: host-a revoked at seq 7; RC7_demote_phone and RC8_demote_phone take manage from dev-phone, on L and on RC7_hs7_revoke; RC7_add_desk adds dev-desk, a native without manage, on L), then the carriage `freeze` (a label of r9-vectors-membership-log's others) when a case names one, which freezes it, each verified at `now_ms`. dev-ipad is the manager E6 removed, dev-phone the one the RC entries demote, dev-mac the current manager that signs the copies. `cases`: check_resigned_copy on the case's list with `original_json`, `copy_json` (exact texts; `original` and `copy` name the file's records when they are) and `candidate_feed_id`: `expect` {original_record_id, copy_record_id, signer (the copy's, member:<id>), principal, action, feed: original | candidate, absent for a host principal's record, which names no feed}, or `code` with `detail` where it has one. The checks, in this order, the first that fails the answer: malformed (either object isn't a signed control record that reads strictly, a non-v4 record_id among them; a candidate_feed_id that isn't a UUID v4; detail which); not_a_stop (the original's action isn't revoke or interrupt_running: a cover, hold or release is never copied, the Station signs those anew with its own key); original_invalid (the original isn't a former or current manager's stop that verifies: detail service_key_signed for the service's own key, host_key_signed for a host's own key, unknown_signer when the list records no key of its member:, not_a_manager for a member that never held manage at any seq, bad_signature when no auth_key that member had in the list's history verifies it; its signer may since have been removed or demoted); copy_invalid (the copy isn't valid at the list's head with a current native manager as its signer: detail verify_control's pending or refusal reason, or signed_by_principal for a record valid under the principal's own key); same_record_id (the copy's record_id is the original's); then the stop intent, field by field in the body's order, the first that differs the answer: intent_mismatch with that field as detail (account_id, genesis_hash, origin, principal, principal_key, action, interrupt_running, revoke_seq, about.integration_id, about.by), but a service's feed_id, which may be the original's (feed original) or candidate_feed_id (feed candidate), else feed_mismatch at its place (after origin). signer, record_id and issued_at may differ; origin never. The field order, the details, the frozen list's refusal (malformed, detail list frozen, as the snapshot checker refuses one), signed_by_principal and the original's signer (a native that held manage at some seq, never the principal's own key) are Atem's readings. What it says: the copy, by a current manager, carries exactly the original's stop intent, so it discharges the original's obligation; whether the original needs one, and the publication's other conditions (the copy in its author's final verified signer report, the final snapshot checked), are the Station's. `checker_passes`: two snapshots check_snapshot_consistency (r9-vectors-host-work-control's snapshot checker, its station-dev origin and candidate feed) finds consistent although their stop isn't a conforming copy of the removed manager's retained original: the checker is effect-only (stop_not_resigned fires only when the snapshot alone drops an effect of the original), and a conforming copy always keeps every effect, so the two never disagree the other way; the copy rule is the adapter's publication rule, built on check_resigned_copy. Each gives its snapshot inputs ({retained, snapshot, marks, covered, provisioned} by record label) with the checker's `expect`, and the copy check's `code` and `detail` for (original, copy).
